verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown/content-extraction API designed to feed clean text to downstream LLMs or agents, not a product that itself surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions on a user's data; its features (VLM captioning, instruction-based field extraction, chunking) are all conversion/extraction utilities rather than insight generation. This axis is a category mismatch for a data-fetching/preprocessing tool.
